item_name: Nutritional Approaches — Feeding tube (e.g., nasogastric or abdominal (PEG))

lookback_source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The item's own pages state a 7-day look-back period for Column 2 (performed while NOT a resident, prior to admission/entry or reentry) and Column 3 (performed while a resident, after admission/entry or reentry); this 7-day window is the assessor's observation window and is consistent with the general convention that the standard MDS 3.0 look-back is 7 days (p. 3-3) counted as ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days (p. 2-17). Two additional, column-specific windows are stated on the item's pages: Column 1 covers days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B, and Column 4 covers the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C. Column 2 is left blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered more than 7 days ago.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed prior to admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period. Leave Column 2 blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered the facility more than 7 days ago.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), completion of K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

source.quote: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), the completion of items K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A feeding tube is the presence of any type of tube that can deliver food/nutritional substances/fluids directly into the gastrointestinal system; examples include but are not limited to nasogastric tubes, gastrostomy tubes, jejunostomy tubes, and percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) tubes.

source.quote: Presence of any type of tube that can deliver food/ nutritional substances/ fluids directly into the gastrointestinal system.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Enteral feeding formulas should not be coded as a mechanically altered diet, and should only be coded as K0520D, Therapeutic Diet, when the enteral formula is altered to manage problematic health conditions.

source.quote: Should only be coded as K0520D, Therapeutic Diet when the enteral formula is altered to manage problematic health conditions, e.g. enteral formulas specific to residents with diabetes.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Skip pattern: complete K0710 only if Column 2 and/or Column 3 are checked for K0520A and/or K0520B.

source.quote: Complete K0710 only if Column 2 and/or Column 3 are checked for K0520A and/or K0520B.

federal.criterion: Review the medical record to determine if any of the listed nutritional approaches (including feeding tube) were performed during the look-back period.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The item's pages tie K0520B to SNF PPS assessment windows (SNF PPS Stay columns 1 and 4) and explicitly require completion of K0520B on the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), a payment assessment. The pages do not otherwise describe a case-mix classification calculation for this item.

source.quote: When completing the Interim Payment Assessment (IPA), the completion of items K0520A, K0520B, and K0520Z is required.

conflicts.topic: Coexistence of multiple stated observation windows for K0520 columns (7-day look-back vs. 3-day SNF PPS Stay windows)

positions.claim: Columns 2 and 3 use a 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the 7-day look-back period.

positions.claim: Column 1 uses days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay and Column 4 uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

source.quote: Check all nutritional approaches performed within the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay.

conflicts.resolution: Resolved by the document itself: each column carries its own stated assessment period (Column 1 = first 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay; Columns 2 and 3 = 7-day look-back; Column 4 = last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay). The 7-day look-back is recorded as the item's observation window.
